title: Platform: Activity
summary: The Platform → Activity page: the product Activity's filters (Anyone, Any action, Any target, Last 7 days) plus a Product facet in one workbench band, Timeline or Table, Export CSV, platform events (a deploy, a setting change, a role given, an invite) beside product events, 'Load more' from the server (one row selected); the detail drawer is admin.platform-activity-event.
compare: One workbench: the facets and the view switch are the table's head band; the Product facet is new beside the four existing ones (admin-4-14).
Never imply a full history from one page: the foot counts what is shown of the range and offers Load more (server pagination).
Permission filtering: a Product admin sees only their products' events and no Platform rows; the Product facet lists only those products.
Platform context, the Pinned K chip, 'Platform' crumb; Export CSV is outlined (no filled primary on a read page).
A row opens the detail drawer (admin.platform-activity-event): before and after, who, when, where.
